caveats: A pass counts as detected under the rule named in `rule`. On empty positions (offset control tracks) that rule fires at about the per-pass rate above.
A body counts as recovered if any one pass is; control tracks fire under the same rule at the per-track rate above (higher for TNOs, see false_detections.by_class).
faintest_recovery is the faintest pass meeting the rules, not a credible limit when controls_fired > 0 (its own control tracks fired on the same frames).
Counts at stricter S/N thresholds are in post_hoc_snr_thresholds; those thresholds were chosen after the controls were seen.

rule: S/N >= 5 in at least two control-corrected detector bands, or S/N >= 50 in the only band measurable; a pass with one band at S/N >= 5 only is 'marginal'

before.rule: best control-corrected band S/N >= 5 (campaign v1 rule)

calibration.split: bodies by CRC-32 of the designation: even A, odd B
calibration.criterion: rule family 'S/N >= 5 in the best band and S/N >= t in the second' with t in {3, 4, 5}: the smallest t whose control-pass rate on half A is at most 1%; half B reported as the check
calibration.note: Half B was not blind: both halves were printed while the rule family was explored. The single-band clause (S/N >= 50 with one band measurable) was added after the data were seen, for a saturated bright pass (Hebe).
